text: Hand dryer or paper towel: which one is cleaner?
Hot air dryers pull in bathroom air, bacteria included, and blow it onto your hands.
Near jet dryers, one study found twenty-seven times more germs in the air.
But the paper industry funded it.
The CDC says both work. The real rule: dry your hands completely.
Wet hands spread germs more easily.
Team towel or team dryer? Comment below!
